text: Do you have any history of autoimmune conditions, or have you started any new medications recently? I also need to know if you have experienced any fever or joint pain alongside these symptoms.

text: The combination of painful blistering rash, oral sores, and a new cough is highly concerning for a severe mucocutaneous reaction. Given the history of arthritis, I need to know if you have ever been prescribed methotrexate or other immunosuppressants for your condition?

text: No, I haven't been prescribed methotrexate or any other immunosuppressants for my arthritis. I only recently started seeing a new primary care provider to manage the arthritis and the cough.

text: Since you mentioned a new cough and oral sores alongside the blistering rash, have you experienced any recent respiratory infections or exposure to tuberculosis? I also need to know if the rash has spread to your eyes or genitals.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the painful blistering rash, oral sores, and new cough, I suspect a severe mucocutaneous reaction like Stevens-Johnson Syndrome. Have you started any new medications, including over-the-counter drugs or supplements, in the past two weeks?

speaker: Doctor
